{{Quote|You're taking me to Captain Vendallan? Thank goodness. I thought the next place I was heading for was a Imperial prison camp.|Vil Sembian, to a spacer|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Vil Sembian''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was the son of [[Daw Sembian]], a famous [[weaponsmith]] who left him his schematic for a new type of [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] which could tip the scales in the Galactic Civil War.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Friend of mine, Vil Sembian -- ever hear of his dad, Daw Sembian, the famous weaponsmith? Doesn't matter, Daw's dead now. He left Vil the schematic for a new kind of blaster. Vil is bringing us the plans, but the Empire's on his tail. I need you to bring him here safely.|[[Nitra Vendallan]], to a spacer|<ref name="AED" />}}
Vil Sembian was the son of [[Daw Sembian]], a famous [[weaponsmith]]. Daw died some [[Time/Legends|time]] prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] and left his son his schematic for a new type of [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] which could tip the scales in favor of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="AED" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Vil Sembian headed to [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to deliver the schematics to his friend, a Rebel [[Captain/Legends|captain]] named [[Nitra Vendallan]].<ref name="AED" />
{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
However, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was on his tail, so Nitra Vendallan sent a Rebel [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to find Sembian and bring him back safely to [[City/Legends|town]]. The spacer fought several [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout trooper]] and [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droid]] to protect Sembian. Despite facing resistance from Imperial forces, the spacer succeeded in escorting Sembian. Vil Vendallan was pleased, and saw to it that the schematic made it to [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]].<ref name="AED" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:CommonerTwilekMaleTemplate.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Possible depictions of Vil Sembian]]
Vil Sembian was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="AED" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

[[File:Vil_Sembian.jpg|thumb|125px|A randomly generated male Aqualish depiction of Vil Sembian on a Japanese server]]
Because Vil Sembian spawned under the generic "commoner_twilek_male" template, his appearance was randomized under one of six possible male Twi'lek depictions. A known screenshot of Vil Sembian exists, depicting him as a randomly generated male [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]]. It should be noted however, that this was a screenshot taken from one of two defunct Japanese servers, which used different character templates for some of its NPCs. Because the American and European servers consistently used the "commoner_twilek_male" template, this article assumes that one of the six male Twi'lek depictions is [[canon]] in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="AED" />
